blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Role-playing prompting has become a popular yet simple technique for improving LLM reasoning and output quality. However, whether it consistently boosts performance across diverse domains remains unclear, as systematic validation is lacking. To fill this gap, we run multi-model, cross-domain, and multilingual experiments on MMLU and MMLU-Redux. We find that gains from role-play prompting depend heavily on model capacity, knowledge domain, and prompt language. Drawing on metacognition theory, we propose the persona-related cognitive alignment hypothesis: role-play works only when the LLM correctly grasps the designated persona and its associated knowledge domain. We test this hypothesis through persona information richness ablation, layer-wise entropy divergence analysis, and latent thought-space deflection observation. To reduce persona cognitive bias and stabilize role-play performance, we propose M ixed- L anguage C oncatenate P rediction (MLCP ), a simple, training-free, and efficient multilingual prompt concatenation strategy. It aggregates semantically equivalent role prompts to enrich complementary representational cues. Extensive experiments show that MLCP consistently outperforms vanilla role-play prompting across all tested LLMs. Our code and implementation details are released at https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/RethinkingRolePlay
blocks.zh: 角色扮演提示已成为一种流行而简单的技术,可以提高LLM推理和输出质量. 然而,由于缺乏系统的验证,它是否始终促进不同领域的业绩仍然不清楚。 为了填补这一空白,我们在MMLU和MMLU-Redux上进行了多模型,跨域,多语言的实验. 我们发现,角色扮演推动的好处在很大程度上取决于模式能力、知识领域和迅速语言。 借鉴元识别理论,我们提出与人物相关的认知对接假设:角色扮演只有在LLM正确把握指定人物及其相关知识领域时才有效. 我们通过人的信息丰富 膨胀, 层层偏移分析 和潜在的思维空间偏移观测来测试这个假设。 为了减少人格的认知偏见和稳定角色扮演表现,我们提出Mixed-Language C oncatenate P Rediction(MLCP),这是一个简单,没有训练,高效的多语种快速凝聚策略. 它汇总了在整体上等同的作用,从而丰富了互补的代表性提示。 广泛的实验表明,MLCP始终超越所有经测试的LLMs所激发的香草角色扮演. 我们的代码和执行细节公布于https://github.com/XMUDEPLIT/RethinkingRolePlay

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recently, Large Language Models (LLM) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in complex reasoning, knowledge-based question answering (QA), and domain-specific tasks Sadeq et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2024) ; Zhao et al. (2025) . As model capabilities evolve, researchers have increasingly found that carefully designed prompts can significantly modulate model behavior. Among these paradigms, role-playing prompting, which assigns specific identities, professions, or expert personas to models, has emerged as a widely adopted strategy. It has proven effective in enhancing performance across a myriad of scenarios, including reasoning, QA, decision support, and autonomous agents. Consequently, implementing persona-based prompts such as "Please answer the following question as an expert in [Domain]" has become a standard practice in current LLM applications.
blocks.zh: 最近,大语言模型(LLM)在复杂的推理,基于知识的问答(QA),以及特定域的任务Sadeq等人(2024),Wang等人(2024),Zhao等人(2025)方面表现出了卓越的能力. 随着模型能力的发展,研究人员越来越多地发现,精心设计的提示可以显著地调制模型行为. 在这些范式中,角色扮演激励(将特定身份、专业或专家指定给模型)已成为广泛采用的战略。 事实证明,它有效地提高了各种情景的绩效,包括推理、质量保证、决策支持和自主代理。 因此,基于人物的应用提示,如"请作为[域]的专家回答以下问题"已经成为当前LLM应用的标准做法.

blocks.zh: 图 1: 领域专家的业绩与角色扮演提示和无角色扮演提示的对比.

blocks.en: However, existing research work predominantly focus on the success cases of role-playing in isolated tasks or specific scenarios, implicitly assuming that role-playing prompts can consistently and unconditionally boost model performance Han and Wang (2024) ; Zheng et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2026) ; Bauer (2026) . As visually illustrated in Figure 1 , this common assumption does not always hold true. A critical question that remains under-explored is: Can role-playing prompting stably and universally enhance LLM performance across diverse domains? In other words, does role-playing prompting function as a universally beneficial capacity-enhancement mechanism, or is it merely a highly conditional task-adaptation strategy?
blocks.zh: 然而,现有的研究工作主要侧重于在孤立的任务或特定情景中角色扮演的成功案例,隐含地假定角色扮演的提示能够持续和无条件地促进模式表现的韩和王(2024年); 郑等人(2024年);张等人(2025年);陈等人(2026年);鲍尔(2026年). 如图1所示,这一共同假设并非总是真实的。 一个仍然未得到充分探讨的关键问题是:角色扮演能否促进均衡和普遍地提高不同领域的LLM性能? 换句话说,角色扮演是作为普遍有利的能力增强机制而发挥的激励作用,还是仅仅是一项高度有条件的任务适应战略?

blocks.en: To systematically investigate this question, we first conducted comprehensive preliminary study to evaluate the impact of role-playing on knowledge-based QA capabilities across multiple mainstream LLMs. Utilizing two extensive multidisciplinary benchmark datasets, MMLU Hendrycks et al. (2020) and MMLU-Redux Gema et al. (2025) , we analyzed the experimental outcomes across three dimensions: overall performance, subject-level comparison, and language form. The empirical results reveal three prominent and intriguing phenomena:
blocks.zh: 为了系统地调查这一问题,我们首先进行了全面的初步研究,以评估角色扮演对基于知识的质量保证能力对多个主流地方政府的影响。 我们利用两个广泛的多学科基准数据集,即MMLU Hendrycks等人(2020年)和MMLU-Redux Gema等人(2025年),分析了三个层面的实验结果:总体绩效、主题层面的比较和语言形式。 经验结果揭示了三个突出和令人感兴趣的现象:

blocks.en: First , in terms of overall performance, role-playing does not yield consistent gains. Models differ substantially in how they respond to role prompts: stronger models tend to benefit more, while weaker ones often gain little or even degrade. This trend is confirmed within the same model series, where improvements rise with model scale. These results suggest that role-playing is not a universally effective strategy and that its effectiveness is closely tied to model capability.
blocks.zh: 第一,就总体业绩而言,角色扮演并不能产生一致的收益。 模型在如何应对角色提示方面大不相同:更强大的模型往往受益更多,而较弱的模型往往得益甚微,甚至退化。 这一趋势在同一个模型系列中得到了证实,其中的改进随着模型规模的增加而增加. 这些结果表明,角色扮演不是一个普遍有效的战略,其效力与模型能力密切相关。

blocks.en: Second , subject-level analysis shows that the benefits of role-playing vary greatly across knowledge domains. Even models from the same family but with different parameter scales can exhibit opposite performance changes on the same subject, and such discrepancies are even more pronounced across different model families. Thus, role-playing does not produce steady gains in any individual subject; its effectiveness is highly conditional, jointly shaped by question type, knowledge domain, and model characteristics.
blocks.zh: 第二,主题层面的分析显示,角色扮演的好处因知识领域而大不相同。 甚至同一家庭的模型,但参数尺度不同,也可以在同一主题上显示相反的性能变化,这种差异在不同的模型家庭中更为明显。 因此,角色扮演并不能在任何单个主题中产生稳定的收益;其有效性是高度有条件的,由问题类型,知识领域,模式特征共同塑造.

blocks.en: Finally , we examine how prompt language affects role-playing performance. Simply changing the language of a role prompt can lead to significantly different outcomes. Notably, even for large-scale models pretrained on massive English and Chinese data, the best performance does not necessarily occur with role prompts in these high-resource languages. For example, Qwen3 performs worse under Chinese role prompts than under certain alternative language variants. These findings suggest that role-playing effectiveness depends not only on the assigned role itself, but also on the prompt language and the knowledge cognition it activates within the model.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们审查迅速的语言如何影响角色扮演的表演. 简单地改变角色提示的语言会导致显著不同的结果。 值得注意的是,即使对大规模模型而言,在大量英文和中文数据上预先进行了培训,但是这些高资源语言中的角色提示并不一定能产生最佳的表现。 例如,Qwen3在中文角色提示下的表现比在某些替代语言变体下表现得更糟. 这些调查结果表明,角色扮演的有效性不仅取决于指定角色本身,还取决于它激活在模型中的迅速语言和知识认知.

blocks.en: Together, these findings show that the widely adopted role-playing strategy is far more intricate than previously assumed. It is neither a universally stable enhancement mechanism nor does it have a standardized optimal template, and its underlying mechanism remains poorly understood. Relying solely on empirical persona design can easily fail to ensure reliable performance gains.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果表明,广泛采用的角色扮演战略远比以前设想的复杂。 它既不是一个普遍稳定的增强机制,也没有一个标准化的最佳模板,其基本机制仍然没有得到很好的了解。 仅仅依靠经验人物设计很容易无法确保可靠的业绩收益。

blocks.en: Driven by these observations, we further investigate the internal mechanisms behind the performance gains and degradations of role-playing prompting. We first analyze several experimental phenomena, including variations in persona information richness, internal entropy fluctuations, and latent thought-space deflections. Inspired by meta-cognition Shaughnessy et al. (2008) , we propose the persona-related cognitive alignment hypothesis to explain the working mechanics of role-playing and persona cognitive biases, and comprehensively validate it. Building on these insights, we introduce Mixed-Language Concatenate Prediction (MLCP), a simple, training-free, and efficient multilingual prompt concatenation strategy that aggregates semantically equivalent role prompts to exploit complementary representational cues and mitigate role-play prompt failures. Experiments confirm that MLCP delivers robust and stable performance improvements across various models and task scenarios.
blocks.zh: 在这些意见的推动下,我们进一步调查促使角色扮演的绩效增减背后的内部机制。 我们首先分析几个实验现象, 包括人的信息丰富度的变化, 内在的py波动, 以及潜在的思维空间偏移。 在元认知Shaughnessy等人(2008年)的启发下,我们提出了与人格相关的认知对接假设,解释角色扮演和人格认知偏见的工作力学,并全面验证. 基于这些见解,我们引入了混合语言组合预测(MLCP),这是一种简单、无培训、高效的多语种快速组合战略,它汇集了在组成上等同的作用,促使人们利用互补的代表提示,减少角色扮演的迅速失败。 实验证实,MLCP在各种模型和任务设想中提供有力和稳定的绩效改进。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: 1. We perform the first systematic evaluation of role-playing in knowledge QA covering extensive diverse subjects across different types of LLMs, benchmarks and prompt languages, and build a comprehensive analytical pipeline to evaluate the effectiveness of role-playing. 2. Multi-dimensional experiments verify that role-playing yields no universal improvements in knowledge QA. Its performance heavily depends on model capability, subject domain and prompt language, demonstrating strong conditionality. We further propose and fully validate the persona-related cognitive alignment hypothesis. 3. We explain how multilingual settings impact role-playing via cognitive space deflection and displacement, and introduce the training-free MLCP strategy to reduce persona cognitive bias. Extensive experiments confirm that MLCP yields steady performance gains as an efficient and lightweight prompt optimization method.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面: 1. 我们首次系统评价知识质量评估中的角色扮演,涵盖不同类型法学硕士、基准和即时语言的广泛不同主题,并建立一个全面的分析渠道,以评估角色扮演的有效性。 2. 多维实验证实,角色扮演不能普遍提高知识质量。 其性能严重依赖于模型能力,主题领域和即时语言,表现出强烈的条件性. 我们进一步提出并充分验证了与人有关的认知一致假设。 3. 我们解释多语种环境如何通过认知空间偏移和迁移影响角色扮演,并采用无培训的MLCP战略,以减少认知偏差。 广泛的实验证实,MLCP作为高效和轻量级的即时优化方法,能产生稳定的性能增益.

blocks.en: 2.2 Observations
blocks.zh: 2.2 意见

blocks.en: Drawing from the empirical findings in Table 1 and Table 2 , we summarize several noteworthy phenomena as follows:
blocks.zh: 根据表1和表2中的经验结论,我们总结了以下几个值得注意的现象:

blocks.en: Phenomenon 1: Role-playing benefits correlate with model capability. Analysis of average accuracies and the count of improved versus degraded subjects reveals that stronger models benefit more substantially from role-playing. Conversely, less capable models yield diminishing or even marginal returns. This pattern is clearly verified within the same model series, where performance improvements gradually rise as the model scale increases.
blocks.zh: 现象 1:角色扮演的好处与模型能力相关。 对平均速率的分析以及改进对象与退化对象的计算表明,较强的模式从角色扮演中受益更大。 相反,能力较差的模型回报率下降甚至微不足道。 这种模式在同一个模型系列中得到了明确的验证,其中的性能改进随着模型尺度的增大而逐渐提高.

blocks.en: Phenomenon 2: Role-playing gains lack universal generalizability and are highly domain-dependent. Subject-level analysis shows no guaranteed boost in any specific domain. Even within the same model family, varying scale or architecture leads to divergent outcomes on identical subjects, indicating that role-playing efficacy is highly conditional—jointly determined by question type and domain.
blocks.zh: 现象 2:角色扮演收益缺乏普遍性,高度依赖域. 主题层面的分析显示,在任何具体领域都没有保证的推动。 即使在同一个模范家族中,不同的规模或结构也会导致在相同主题上产生不同的结果,表明角色扮演的功效是高度有条件的——由问题类型和领域共同决定的.

blocks.en: Phenomenon 3: Linguistic phrasing in role-playing prompts significantly impacts performance gains. Evaluating prompts across different languages suggests that the language choice alters final gains. Remarkably, even models pre-trained on massive English and Chinese corpora do not consistently optimalize in these dominant languages (e.g., Qwen3 underperforms in Chinese compared to other variations).
blocks.zh: 现象 3: 角色扮演的语言措辞促使显著影响业绩收益。 评价不同语言的提示表明,语言选择改变了最终收益。 值得注意的是,即使是在大规模英语和汉语corpora上进行预训的模型,在这些主导语言中也没有一致的优化(例如,与其他变体相比,中文的Qune3表现不佳).

blocks.en: 2.3 Mechanistic Hypothesis
blocks.zh: 2.3 机械假设

blocks.en: The divergent outcomes observed across different models, subjects, and languages suggest that the impact of role-playing is not superficial, but is deeply rooted in how models internalize assigned identities. Drawing inspiration from the meta-cognition concept Shaughnessy et al. (2008) , we propose a mechanistic hypothesis centered on persona-related cognitive alignment : the efficacy of role-playing hinges on whether the LLM accurately conceptualizes the designated persona and its corresponding knowledge domain. Correct conceptualization triggers performance gains, while cognitive deviations hinder them.
blocks.zh: 不同模型、主题和语言之间观察到的不同结果表明,角色扮演的影响不是表面的,而是深深植根于模型如何将指定身份内部化。 我们从元识别概念Shaughnessy等人(2008年)中汲取灵感,提出以人与人相关认知对接为核心的机械假设:角色扮演的功效取决于LLM是否准确概念化指定人物a及其相应的知识领域. 正确的概念化触发性能收益,而认知偏差则阻碍它们.

blocks.en: 2.4 Validation of the Proposed Hypothesis
blocks.zh: 2.4 审定拟议的假设

blocks.en: This premise is initially supported by the performance of Qwen3 across various scales in Tables 1 and 2 , where larger parameter sizes naturally expand the model’s epistemic capacity, leading to better persona comprehension. To rigorous evaluate this hypothesis, we provide further empirical justifications through three analytical lenses: persona informational richness divergence, internal entropy evolution, and thought-space deflection.
blocks.zh: 这一前提最初得到了表1和表2中Quen3在不同尺度上的性能的支持,更大的参数大小自然地扩大了模型的感知能力,从而导致更好的人性理解. 为了严格评价这个假设,我们通过三个分析透镜提供了进一步的经验性解释:人物(permana)信息丰富性差异,内演化,和思想空间偏移.

blocks.en: Validation 1. To verify that an LLM’s cognitive deviation regarding persona information directly dictates its performance gains in role-playing tasks, we conduct a controlled experiment using Qwen3-4B, the weaker model in the Qwen3 series. Specifically, we target subjects where role-playing prompts deliver subpar gains on the MMLU-Redux benchmark. Our experimental paradigm proceeds by systematically injecting role-playing prompts with persona specifications varying in their degree of informational richness. By evaluating how the completeness of persona profiles affects task performance, we aim to establish a clear causal link between the model’s cognitive deviations and its subsequent performance fluctuations.
blocks.zh: 验证 1. 为了核实一个LLM对人的信息的认知偏差直接决定它在角色扮演任务中的性能收益,我们利用Qune3-4B,即Qune3系列中较弱的模型进行控制实验. 具体地说,我们针对的是角色扮演促使在MMLU-Redux基准上实现次级收益的主题。 我们的实验范式通过系统地向角色扮演提示注入其信息丰富程度各不相同的人物规格来进行。 通过评价人物剖面图的完整性如何影响任务性能,我们的目标是在模型的认知偏差与随后的性能波动之间建立明确的因果关系.

blocks.en: To eliminate experimental interference from text styling and linguistic expressions, all supplementary persona information is standardized via GPT-5.5 generation, maintaining informational richness as the single controlled variable. We construct three comparative prompt tiers: the Simple , Moderate , and Rich versions (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 为了消除文本造型和语言表达方式的实验干扰,所有补充人物信息都通过GPT-5.5生成实现标准化,保持信息丰富性作为单一的控制变量. 我们构建三个相对的快速级:简单版、中度版和丰富版(附录C)。

blocks.en: Table 3: Performance deviation of Qwen3-4B under incremental persona information richness settings, where values denote relative performance changes of role-playing prompts compared to the base prompt.
blocks.zh: 表3:在增量人物a信息丰富度设置下Quen3-4B的性能偏差,其值表示角色扮演提示相对于基点提示的相对性能变化.

blocks.en: As demonstrated by the empirical results in Table 3 , although performance improvements are observed in most scenarios, role-playing configurations still underperform the baseline across several specific subjects. This phenomenon stems from the model’s restricted epistemic capacity. For a model with such constrained expertise, the injection of supplementary persona information merely serves as a partial mitigation strategy rather than a radical remedy for its underlying knowledge gaps. For instance, in anatomy and college_physics , expanding the prompt from the Simple Version to the Rich Version either merely mitigates the performance deficit (from − 9 % -9\% to − 4 % -4\% ) or at best brings it back to the baseline ( 0 % 0\% ), failing to yield any net positive gains over the baseline.
blocks.zh: 如表3的经验结果所示,虽然在大多数情景中都看到业绩的改善,但角色扮演组合在若干具体主题上仍然表现不佳。 这种现象源于该模型的认知能力有限。 对于具备这种有限专门知识的模型,注入补充人的信息只是作为部分缓解战略,而不是从根本上弥补其基本知识差距。 例如,在解剖学和大学物理学中,从简易版本扩展出富豪版本的速率,要么只是减轻性能缺陷(从−9%-9%-%到−4%-——4%-%),要么充其量是使其回到基线(0%-0-%),未能取得比基线的任何净正收益。

blocks.en: Crucially, in certain instances, inflating the prompt with excessive contextual details even introduces cognitive noise that actively degrades performance. A prime example is human_aging , where the performance gap stands at − 4 % -4\% in the Simple Version, recovers to 0 % 0\% in the Moderate Version, but precipitously drops to − 3 % -3\% in the Rich Version. This performance degradation arises from excessively redundant persona descriptions, which not only fail to cover the essential knowledge needed to answer targeted questions but also exacerbate cognitive biases, disrupting the model’s judgment.
blocks.zh: 关键是,在某些情况下,用过多的背景细节来夸大提示,甚至引入认知噪声,积极降解性能. 一个主要的例子就是人性化(human_aging),在简单版本中,性能差距为−4% - 4\%,在中度版本中恢复到0% 0\%,但在富人版本中急剧下降到−3% - 3\%. 这种性能退化源于过分冗余的人的描述,这种描述不仅没有涵盖回答目标问题所需的基本知识,而且还加剧了认知偏见,扰乱了模型的判断。

blocks.en: Validation 2. Our second verification lens formalizes the logical chain: cognitive deviation → \rightarrow representational ambiguity → \rightarrow internal entropy evolution . Without precise persona conceptualization, the model suffers inference-time cognitive confusion. It cannot efficiently activate relevant knowledge weights, raising uncertainty in intermediate representations; this structural mismatch produces volatile entropy shifts Liu et al. (2026) . We thus calculate layer-wise entropy divergence between role-play and baseline settings, with results plotted in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 验证 2. 我们的第二个核查镜头使逻辑链正式化:认知偏差 ~ 右倾代表模糊 ~ 右倾内向演化. 没有精确的人物概念化,模型会遭受推断-时间认知混乱. 它不能高效地激活相关知识权重,提高中间代表物的不确定性;这种结构不匹配产生挥发性的 en转移Liu等人(2026年). 因此,我们计算了角色扮演和基线设置之间的层次偏差,结果如图2所示。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Layer-wise entropy difference across transformer layers for Qwen3-4B/8B/14B on the MMLU-Redux benchmark. Entropy is computed from the final-token hidden state at each layer after projection through the language model head, measuring the model’s predictive uncertainty for the next token. Positive values indicate that role-playing prompts increase uncertainty compared to base setting.
blocks.zh: 图2:MMLU-Redux基准上的Qune3-4B/8B/14B型变压器层之间的层位偏差. Entropy 是在通过语言模型头进行投影后从每一层的终键隐藏状态计算出来的,用于测量模型对下一个符号的预测不确定性. 积极价值表明角色扮演提示比基础设定增加不确定性.

blocks.en: Entropy divergence stays close to zero in the first 16 shallow feature-extraction layers. Sharp separation arises in layers 20–35, the deep semantic abstraction and decision stage. The stronger Qwen3-14B resolves representational ambiguity and clearly partitions persona knowledge, maintaining near-zero, steady entropy divergence across layers. In contrast, weaker Qwen3-4B/8B exhibit severe cognitive deviation and confusion. Their hidden states suffer strong inter-layer conflicts, driving wild entropy fluctuations in mid-to-late layers—the network segments responsible for high-level semantic integration and persona alignment.
blocks.zh: 在前16个浅层特征提取层中,Entropy difference保持接近0. 尖锐的分离产生于第20–35层,深度语义抽象和决定阶段. 更强的Qwen3-14B解决了表征模糊性,并明确分割了人物a知识,保持了近乎零,平稳的 en分层. 相比之下,较弱的Quen3-4B/8B表现出严重的认知偏差和混乱. 他们隐藏的状态遭受了强烈的层际冲突,在中后层驱动着野生的肽类波动——负责高层次语义集成和人文调和的网络部分.

blocks.en: Validation 3. Our third analytical lens examines thought-space deflection to substantiate our hypothesis. Specifically, we select three representative subjects from Qwen3-8B characterized by the maximum positive gain, maximum negative gain, and neutral performance under role-playing setups. We analyze their internal hidden states by calculating the L ​ 2 L2 Euclidean norms and applying PCA Abdi and Williams (2010) dimensionality reduction to map the representations into a 2D space.
blocks.zh: 验证 3. 我们的第三个分析镜头审查了思想空间偏移,以证实我们的假设。 具体来说,我们从Qwen3-8B中选择了三个具有代表性的主题,其特点是在角色扮演设定下获得最大正增益,最大负增益,以及中性表现. 我们通过计算L 2 L 2 欧几利得规范, 并应用 PCA Abdi 和 Williams (2010年) 的维度降低来分析它们内部隐藏的状态, 将表达图映射到一个二维空间。

blocks.en: As depicted in Figure 3 , both the maximum-positive and maximum-negative gain subjects exhibit conspicuous deflection amplitudes, but their shifting orientations are distinctly divergent. In contrast, the subject with no performance variance demonstrates negligible spatial shift. This provides explicit evidence that role-playing persona prompts trigger geometric deflections within the model’s inner representation space. Crucially, while the performance variance dictates the magnitude of this spatial deflection, the specific direction of the deflection is rooted in the model’s cognitive alignment or deviation regarding the persona, which fundamentally determines whether role-playing enhances or degrades model utility.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,最大阳性和最大阴性增益的主体都表现出明显的偏移振幅,但它们的转向方向明显不同。 与此相反,没有性能差异的主体显示出可忽略不计的空间变化。 这提供了明确的证据表明角色扮演人物a 触发了模型内部代表空间内的几何偏移. 关键是,虽然性能差异决定了这种空间偏移的程度,但偏移的具体方向植根于模型对人物的认知对调或偏移,这从根本上决定了角色扮演是增强还是降低模型的效用.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Comparison of hidden representation space deflection derived from layer-averaged states between base and role-playing prompting on multiple MMLU-Redux subjects.
blocks.zh: 图3:从层平均状态得到的隐藏表示空间偏移比较,在多个MMLU-Redux主题上激发基态和角色扮演态.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Our preliminary study demonstrates that the effectiveness of role-playing prompting is highly sensitive to prompt formulation, particularly the linguistic expression of expert profiles. This observation suggests that different linguistic realizations of semantically equivalent role prompts may induce diverse internal representations within LLM. However, manually identifying an optimal prompt formulation remains challenging, as users typically lack prior knowledge about which linguistic representation can better align with the expertise required for a given task.
blocks.zh: 我们的初步研究表明,激发角色扮演的效果对迅速的表达,特别是专家简介的语言表达,非常敏感。 这一观点表明,不同语言对等作用的实现可能诱发LLM内部的多种表达. 但是,人工确定最佳的即时表述仍然具有挑战性,因为用户通常缺乏事先的知识,无法了解哪些语言表述能更好地与特定任务所需的专门知识保持一致。

blocks.en: To investigate this phenomenon, we analyze the geometric characteristics of hidden representations elicited by role-playing prompts across different languages. Specifically, we measure the angular distances and positional shifts among hidden representation spaces induced by multilingual role prompts, as shown in Figure 4 . The results reveal that different languages introduce distinct representation deviations within the LLM’s latent space, suggesting that multilingual formulations provide diverse representation patterns for the same semantic instruction. These geometric observations motivate us to explore whether language-induced representation diversity can be leveraged during inference. As illustrated in Figure 5 , different linguistic realizations of the same role prompt correspond to different regions in the representation space. Instead of selecting a single prompt formulation, composing multiple language-specific role prompts provides the model with complementary representation cues within a unified context.
blocks.zh: 为了调查这种现象,我们分析了不同语言角色扮演提示所引发的隐藏表现的几何特征. 具体来说,如图4所示,我们测量了多语种角色提示引起的隐藏代表空间之间的角距和位置变化。 结果表明,不同语言在LLM的潜在空间中引入了不同的表示偏差,这表明多语种的表达方式为同一语义教学提供了不同的表示模式。 这些几何观测促使我们探讨在推论中是否可以利用语言引起的代表多样性。 如图5所示,对同一角色的不同语言实现迅速与代表空间的不同区域相对应。 组合多种语言特定角色提示而不是选择单一的即时表达方式,而是在统一的语境中为模型提供互补的表示提示.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Spatial geometric analysis of hidden representations elicited by Qwen3-14B. (a) Pairwise angular distances between mean representation centroids induced by role-playing prompts in eight languages. (b) 2D PCA visualization of last-layer hidden states.
blocks.zh: 图4:Qwen3-14B引申的隐藏表示的空间几何分析。 (a) 由8种语言的角色扮演提示诱导的平均代表人中间角距。 (b) 2D PCA可视化末层隐藏状态。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Illustration of multilingual role-playing prompt composition. Different languages induce diverse representation patterns, and their composition provides a broader inference context.
blocks.zh: 图5:多语种角色扮演快速构成图解. 不同语言诱导不同的代表模式,其构成提供了更广泛的推论背景.

blocks.en: Inspired by self-consistency mechanisms Wang et al. (2022) , multilingual prompting for generation diversity Wang et al. (2025b) , and prompt repetition strategies Leviathan et al. (2025) , we propose Mixed-Language Concatenate Prediction (MLCP) , an inference-time strategy that composes semantically equivalent role-playing prompts expressed in different languages before generation. Different from conventional self-consistency approaches that independently sample multiple responses and aggregate predictions, MLCP performs multilingual prompt composition within a single inference process, enabling the model to jointly utilize diverse linguistic role cues.
blocks.zh: 受自我一致机制的启发 Wang et al. (2022),多语种激发世代多样性 Wang et al. (2025b),以及即时重复策略 Leviathan et al. (2025),我们提议混合语言复合预测(MLCP),一种推论-时间策略,它构成在世代前用不同语言表达的相當角色扮演提示. 与独立抽样多种反应和综合预测的常规自相容性方法不同,MLCP在单一推论过程中进行多语种即时构成,使模型能够联合利用多种语言角色提示.

blocks.en: Unlike conventional self-consistency strategies that independently sample multiple responses and aggregate predictions, MLCP performs multilingual prompt composition before inference, allowing the model to jointly process diverse linguistic role cues within a single context. By integrating multiple linguistic realizations of the same expert profile, MLCP aims to exploit complementary representation patterns induced by different languages, thereby improving the robustness and generalization of role-playing prompting.
blocks.zh: 与独立抽样多个响应和汇总预测的常规自相容性策略不同,MLCP在推论前进行多语种即时构成,使模型可以在单一上下文中联合处理多种语言角色提示. MLCP通过整合同一专家简介的多种语言实现,旨在利用不同语言引发的互补表现模式,从而提高角色扮演提示的强性和概括性.

blocks.en: To further investigate the underlying factors contributing to the effectiveness of multilingual prompt composition, we design three controlled alignment strategies: (a) Mixed-Language Voting Prediction (MLVP) : independently generates responses from semantically equivalent prompts expressed in multiple languages and obtains the final prediction through majority voting; (b) Single-Language Voting Prediction (SLVP) : repeatedly samples responses using a single-language role prompt and aggregates predictions through majority voting; (c) Single-Language Concatenate Prediction (SLCP) : repeat and concatenate identical monolingual role prompts to disentangle prompt effects from multilingual representational diversity.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步调查有助于多语种即时构成效力的基本因素,我们设计了三种可控的组合策略:(a) 混合语言投票预测:(MLVP) 独立生成以多种语言表达的等效提示的响应,并通过多数表决获得最终预测;(b) 单一语言投票预测:(SLVP) 通过多数表决多次使用单一语言角色即时预测样本和汇总预测;(c) 单一语言连结预测:(SLCP) 重复和归纳相同的单一语言角色,以迅速消除多种语言代表多样性的迅速影响。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 实验结果和分析

blocks.en: 4.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.1 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 4 summarizes the performance of the proposed variant across multiple models. Among all variants, MLCP achieves the best overall performance and outperforms the other three variants on most benchmarks and model. Meanwhile, it yields significant performance gains compared with the unoptimized role-playing setup.
blocks.zh: 表4总结了拟议变式在多种模式中的表现。 在所有变种中,MLCP取得了最佳的整体性能,并在大多数基准和模型上超过了其他三个变种. 同时,与未优化的角色扮演设置相比,它取得了显著的业绩收益。

blocks.en: In addition, we present the subject count comparison between the role-playing and MLCP setting in Table 5 . It can be observed that, under the MLCP strategy, the number of subjects yielding positive gains increases markedly, while the number of subjects showing negative gains decreases substantially. This trend suggests that MLCP not only enhances overall prediction performance but, more critically, effectively alleviates the cognitive bias commonly observed in role-playing scenarios. Specifically, grounded in the cognitive deviation hypothesis validated by our preliminary study, different linguistic phrasings induce distinct spatial deflections within the model’s epistemic representation space. By concatenating identical-semantic multilingual prompts, MLCP integrates multiple heterogeneous cognitive spaces, achieving broader topological alignment and overlap with the prerequisite domain expertise required to correctly address the target task. This multi-angle persona alignment effectively counteracts underlying cognitive deviations and expands the intersection between the model’s epistemic boundaries and the necessary expert knowledge, ultimately maximizing role-playing performance gains.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们提出表5中角色扮演和MLCP设定的主题数比较。 可以看出,在《中期方案纲要》战略下,取得积极成果的主体数量显著增加,而出现负收益的主体数量大幅减少。 这一趋势表明,MLCP不仅可以增强总体预测性能,而且更重要的是,可以有效缓解角色扮演情景中常见的认知偏差. 具体地说,基于我们初步研究所证实的认知偏差假设,不同的语言措辞在模型的感官表达空间中诱发不同的空间偏移。 通过调和相同语义的多语种提示,MLCP融合了多种多样化的认知空间,实现了更广泛的地形协调,并与正确处理目标任务所需的先决条件域专业知识重叠. 这种多角人调和有效地抵消了基本的认知偏差,扩大了模型的认知边界与必要的专家知识之间的交汇点,最终将角色扮演的性能收益最大化.

blocks.en: 4.2 Quantitative Analysis of Mixed Languages
blocks.zh: 4.2 混合语言的定量分析

blocks.en: This section aims to quantitatively investigate the impact of the number of mixed languages ( N ) incorporated into the input on the final performance of the MLCP variant. To eliminate biases introduced by specific language combinations, for each given N ( N =2, 4, 6, 8), we randomly selected different language combinations from the overall language pool and conducted multiple independent trials, computing the average accuracy across all runs. The experimental results are presented in Figure 6 . A clear and consistent monotonic upward trend can be observed: as the number of mixed languages increases from 2 to 8, the average accuracy of the model rises substantially, indicating that the model benefits from exposure to a more diverse set of languages.

blocks.en: This finding strongly corroborates the original design rationale of the MLCP variant articulated in our methodology. As theorized, variations in linguistic phrasing can be conceptualized as distinct geometric deflections within the model’s cognitive space, and the degree of overlap between these deflected spaces and the prerequisite domain knowledge directly determines task performance. By concatenating semantically equivalent prompts across an increasing number of languages, MLCP effectively constructs a more comprehensive and multi-angle persona alignment, expanding the intersection between the model’s cognitive boundaries and the required expert knowledge. The monotonic performance gain with increasing N , as demonstrated in Figure 6 , directly provides empirical support: a broader spectrum of linguistic phrasings induces richer spatial deflections, which in turn yields more thorough coverage of the target knowledge space. This quantitative analysis thus provides solid empirical evidence for the efficacy of the MLCP framework, confirming that leveraging multilingual diversity constitutes a viable path toward maximizing role-playing performance gains.
blocks.zh: 这一结论有力地证实了我们方法中阐述的MLCP变体最初的设计原理。 随着理论的推论,语言措辞的变化可以被概念化为模型认知空间内独特的几何偏移,这些偏移空间与先决条件域知识之间的重叠程度直接决定任务性能. MLCP通过凝聚成像等效的提示,跨越越来越多的语言,有效地构建了更全面和多角的人物组合,扩大了模型认知界限和所需专家知识之间的交叉点。 如图6所示,单调性能随着N的增加而增加,直接提供了经验性支持:更广泛的语言措辞诱发更丰富的空间偏移,从而更彻底地覆盖目标知识空间。 因此,这一定量分析为多语言方案框架的有效性提供了坚实的经验证据,确认利用多种语言的多样性是最大限度地发挥角色扮演性业绩收益的可行途径。

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Role-playing prompting has emerged as a lightweight, cost-effective paradigm for optimizing LLMs. Without expensive fine-tuning, it regulates outputs, mitigates hallucinations, and enhances task adaptability through persona alignment and behavioral constraints Kong et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2025a) . Consequently, it has been widely adopted across natural language generation, intelligent dialogue, and logical reasoning. It also plays a pivotal role in frontiers such as multi-agent collaboration, LLM harness, and skills design, serving as a core mechanism to orchestrate agent division of labor and activate specialized capabilities within general-purpose foundation models He et al. (2023) ; Wu et al. (2025) ; Ruangtanusak et al. (2025) ; Xu et al. (2026) ; Lee et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 角色扮演激励已经成为一种轻量级、成本效益高的优化有限责任公司模式。 没有昂贵的微调,它调节输出,减轻幻觉,并通过人物调和和行为约束增强任务适应能力 Kong等人(2024); Wang等人(2025a). 因此,它在自然语言生成、智能对话和逻辑推理方面得到广泛采用。 它还在多代理协作、LLM利用和技能设计等前沿领域发挥关键作用,作为协调代理分工和在通用基础模型中激活专门能力的核心机制。

blocks.en: Despite its undeniable practical utility, current research on role-playing prompting is constrained by pronounced contextual limitations. Most existing studies focus heavily on isolated scenarios including interactive dialogue Shanahan et al. (2023) ; Njifenjou et al. (2024) , creative writing Chen et al. (2024) , or mathematical logical reasoning Han and Wang (2024) ; Kim et al. (2024) ; Peng and Shang (2026) , and merely validate the efficacy or necessity of role-playing under localized task settings. Consequently, these findings remain fragmented empirical observations tailored to specific applications, lacking a generalized and holistic perspective De Araujo et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 尽管其无可否认的实际效用,但目前关于角色扮演诱导的研究受到明显背景限制的限制。 大多数现有研究主要侧重于孤立的情景,包括互动对话Shanahan等人(2023年);Njifenjou等人(2024年);创造性写作Chen等人(2024年),或数学逻辑推理Han和Wang(2024年);Kim等人(2024年);Peng和Shang(2026年),仅仅验证了本地化任务设置下角色扮演的功效或必要性. 因此,这些调查结果仍然是针对具体应用的零散的经验性观察,缺乏对De Araujo等人(2025年)的全面和整体观点。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This paper challenges the prevailing belief that role-playing universally enhances LLM performance. Through comprehensive experiments, we demonstrate that its efficacy correlates with multiple factors, including model capability, target subject, and prompt language. Specifically, stronger models benefit significantly, whereas weaker ones often suffer degradation; furthermore, no single domain yields equal performance gains across all models through role-playing, and high-resource languages do not guarantee optimal results.
blocks.zh: 本文对普遍认为角色扮演能普遍提高LLM性能的观念提出了挑战. 通过全面实验,我们表明其效力与多种因素相关,包括模型能力、目标对象和迅速语言。 具体地说,较强的模型大有裨益,而较弱的模型则往往退化;此外,没有任何一个领域通过角色扮演在所有模型中产生同等的业绩收益,高资源语言不能保证最佳结果。

blocks.en: Mechanistically, our analysis indicates that role-playing functions as a conditional knowledge activation mechanism. Performance correlates with the model’s cognitive alignment with the target persona; deviations manifest as representational ambiguity, entropy fluctuations, and thought-space deflection, ultimately undermining results. Building on this, we propose multilingual alignment strategies, particularly MLCP, to effectively expand the intersection between model cognition and domain expertise. Our work provides a rigorous foundation for optimizing role-playing, emphasizing context-aware, mechanism-driven design over simplistic empirical adoption.
blocks.zh: 在机械方面,我们的分析表明,角色扮演是一种有条件的知识激活机制。 性能与模型的认知与目标人a 的一致有关;偏差表现为表现模糊、py波动和思维空间偏移,最终会破坏结果。 在此基础上,我们提出了多语种协调战略,特别是多语种协调战略,以有效扩大模型认知与领域专长之间的交叉。 我们的工作为优化角色扮演提供了坚实的基础,强调环境意识,机制驱动的设计,而不是简单的经验性采纳.

blocks.en: Limitation
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our evaluation covers six open-weight models from three families, none above 32B, on two multiple-choice knowledge QA benchmarks, so the correlation between role-playing gains and model capability is established mainly within the Qwen3 series and should be read as a well-supported hypothesis rather than a universal law; extending it to larger models, other families, and open-ended or interactive settings is a natural next step. The persona-related cognitive alignment hypothesis is an interpretive framework supported by three converging lines of evidence—persona-richness manipulation, layer-wise entropy divergence, and thought-space deflection—each with its own confounds, and our mechanistic analyses concentrate on the Qwen3 family, which provides a controlled setting for isolating scale effects, so the evidence is consistent with the hypothesis rather than a direct proof. Our multilingual comparison varies the persona-instruction language while keeping questions in English, so the observed cross-language variation reflects both persona-related and general cross-lingual effects. Finally, MLCP is deliberately simple and training-free, and its contribution lies in showing that pre-inference composition of semantically equivalent role prompts yields stable gains over vanilla role-playing; because it lengthens the input, the accuracy-cost trade-off and adaptive language selection remain open questions.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价涵盖来自三个家庭的6个不高于32B的开放式模型,在两个多选择知识QA基准上,因此角色扮演收益和模型能力之间的关联主要在Quen3系列中建立,应该被解读为一个得到良好支持的假说,而不是一个普世法;将其扩展至更大的模型,其他家庭,开放式或互动环境是自然的下一步. 人与人相关的认知对齐假说是一个解释性框架,由三条一致的证据线支持——人富操纵,层层反射偏差,和思想空间偏移——每个线条都有自己的困惑,我们的机械分析集中于Qune3家族,它为隔离尺度效应提供了一个可控的设定,因此证据与假说一致,而不是直接的证据. 我们的多语种比较在将问题保留在英语中的同时,也改变了人文教学语言,因此所观察到的跨语种变异既反映了人文相关效果,也反映了一般的跨语种效果. 最后,MLCP是有意的简单和无培训的,它的贡献在于显示,推论前对等角色的构成促使人们比香草角色扮演产生稳定的收益;因为它延长了输入,准确成本的权衡和适应性语言的选择仍然是未解的问题.

blocks.en: A.2 What Are the Advantages of Our Work?
blocks.zh: A.2 我们工作的优点是什么?

blocks.en: The core vulnerability of existing research lies in the absence of a systematic, generalized analysis of the underlying mechanisms driving role-playing prompting. Crucial foundational questions remain unanswered within the academic community: Is role-playing prompting a universal enhancement mechanism capable of comprehensively boosting model performance, or is it merely a contextual adaptation strategy heavily dependent on task-specific attributes? Present research lacks cross-task and cross-domain comparative validation. As a result, the precise functional boundaries, optimal adaptive conditions, and failure modes of this strategy remain obscured, leaving the performance variance across different tasks unexplained.
blocks.zh: 现有研究的核心脆弱性在于,没有对促使发挥作用的基本机制进行系统、广泛的分析。 在学术界,关键的基本问题仍未解答: 角色扮演是否促使建立能够全面提升模型性能的普遍增强机制,还是仅仅是一种主要取决于具体任务属性的背景适应战略? 目前的研究缺乏跨任务和跨领域比较验证. 因此,这一战略的精确功能界限、最佳适应条件和失败模式仍然模糊不清,使不同任务的业绩差异无法解释。

blocks.en: In summary, current exploration remains confined to single-scenario validation and localized optimization, lacking a systematic inquiry into the intrinsic nature, universal validity, and task dependency of role-playing prompts. This gap severely hinders the generalized deployment and iterative optimization of this paradigm. To address these research desiderata, this paper systematically investigates the underlying mechanisms of role-playing prompting. Through comprehensive multilingual and multi-domain comparative experiments, we delineate its universal empowerment capabilities and contextual adaptation boundaries, thereby filling a critical void in prior work.
blocks.zh: 总之,目前的探索仍然局限于单一情景验证和局部优化,缺乏对角色扮演提示的内在性质、普遍有效性和任务依赖性的系统调查。 这一差距严重阻碍了这一模式的普遍部署和迭代优化。 为解决这些研究,本文系统地调查了促使角色扮演的基本机制。 通过全面的多语种和多领域比较实验,我们划定了其普遍增强权能的能力和背景适应界限,从而填补了先前工作中的一个关键空白。

blocks.en: A.3 Is MLCP Merely an Incremental Extension of Existing Prompt Composition Strategies?
blocks.zh: A.3 MLCP是否仅仅是现有快速组成战略的逐步延长?

blocks.en: At the mechanism level, yes: MLCP composes semantically equivalent multilingual role prompts and is inspired by self-consistency, multilingual prompting, and prompt repetition, so we do not claim a new inference method. This is deliberately an analysis-heavy, method-light paper: before proposing MLCP, we conduct a multi-model, cross-domain, multilingual evaluation of role-play prompting on MMLU and MMLU-Redux, propose the persona-related cognitive alignment hypothesis, and validate it through persona-richness ablation, layer-wise entropy divergence, and thought-space deflection, as well as a cross-lingual representation analysis showing that different languages induce distinct geometric deflections for the same persona; MLCP is the minimal strategy derived directly from these findings. That MLCP is simple is thus intentional, and it is not reducible to repetition: SLCP—which repeats and concatenates monolingual prompts, matching MLCP in length, repetition, and input diversity—is outperformed by MLCP in most settings (Table 4 ), and MLCP improves monotonically as the number of languages grows from 2 to 8 (Figure 6 ), which a pure repetition account would not predict.

question; this is not equivalent to prompt length or injected information. We therefore use
richness only as a perturbation of the persona representation, not as a measurement of
conceptualization. If gains were driven solely by additional cues, richer prompts should
improve performance monotonically. Our results contradict this: on human_aging ,
performance moves from − 4 % -4\% (Simple) to 0 % 0\% (Moderate) and then to − 3 % -3\% (Rich), and on anatomy and college_physics richness only mitigates the deficit without

generic cues alone. We acknowledge that richness co-varies with length and specificity, and
thus treat this as one of three converging signals rather than a standalone proof; isolating
persona alignment via length-controlled or domain-mismatched variants is left for future work.

blocks.en: B.1 Datasets

blocks.en: We evaluate these models on two multiple-choice benchmarks characterized by broad disciplinary coverage: • MMLU Hendrycks et al. (2020) , a comprehensive benchmark comprising 57 fine-grained subjects that span a wide range of domains, including the humanities, social sciences, and STEM. It is designed to evaluate models’ broad knowledge and reasoning capabilities across diverse academic disciplines, covering areas such as history, law, mathematics, physics, and computer science. • MMLU-Redux Gema et al. (2025) , a refined variant of MMLU comprising 30 subjects, explicitly curated to eliminate potential label noise and ambiguous items. By removing noisy or problematic questions, MMLU-Redux provides a cleaner and more reliable evaluation set, making it better suited for accurately assessing model performance and reducing evaluation bias.

blocks.en: As described in Section 2.1 (Study Setup) of the main paper, we extend role-play evaluation to multilingual scenarios. To simulate real-world interactions where users naturally craft role-playing prompts in their native languages, we extend the role-playing evaluation into a multilingual scenario. We translate the persona instructions into eight distinct languages: English (en), Chinese (zh), Spanish (es), French (fr), Japanese (ja), German (de), Khmer (km), and Malay (ms). Crucially, these prompts maintain strict semantic equivalence, isolating language as the sole independent variable. The specific multilingual prompts are illustrated in Figure 7 .

blocks.en: We supplement the subject-level results for both benchmarks. MMLU-Redux results are reported in Tables 10 and 11 , covering 30 subjects across Mistral-7B, Llama3-8B, Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B. MMLU results are split across Tables 12 – 14 due to the larger number of subjects (57 in total).
blocks.zh: 我们补充了两个基准的主题层面的结果。 MMLU-Redux结果在表10和表11中报告,涵盖整个Mistral-7B,Llama3-8B,Qune3-4B,Qune3-8B,Qune3-14B和Qune3-32B的30个学科. MMLU的结果在表12 – 14之间划分,因为科目较多(共计57个).

blocks.en: These tables reveal that role-playing effects are highly conditional. The same model can improve on some subjects and degrade on others, and models of different scales within the same family can even move in opposite directions on the same subject. For example, on MMLU-Redux anatomy, Qwen3-4B drops by 9% while Qwen3-14B gains 1%; on college_physics , Qwen3-4B drops by 7% while Qwen3-8B gains 5%. No subject shows consistent gains across all models. These observations reinforce the paper’s central claim that role-playing is not a universal enhancement mechanism but a context-dependent adaptation strategy shaped jointly by model capability, knowledge domain, and question type.
blocks.zh: 这些表格显示角色扮演效果是高度有条件的. 同样的模型可以在某些学科上有所改进,在另一些学科上有所降解,在同一家族内不同尺度的模型甚至可以在同一学科上向相反的方向移动. 例如,在MMLU-Redux解剖学上,Quen3-4B下降9%,而Quen3-14B则增加1%;在大学_物理上,Quen3-4B下降7%,而Quen3-8B则增加5%. 没有哪一个主题显示所有模式的一贯收益。 这些意见强化了文件的核心主张,即角色扮演并不是一种普遍增强机制,而是一种由模型能力、知识领域和问题类型共同形成的基于具体情况的适应战略。

blocks.zh: 附录E SLVP 和 SLCP 变体中每种语言的性能

blocks.en: Table 15 reports the full language-level results for SLVP and SLCP across eight languages (en, zh, ja, km, ms, de, es, fr) on MMLU-Redux and MMLU. The main text selects only the best-performing language from each variant family as a comparison baseline; this table provides the complete picture.
blocks.zh: 表15报告在MMLU-Redux和MMLU上的8种语言(en, zh, ja, km, ms, de, es, fr)的SLVP和SLCP的全部语言级别结果。 主文只从每个变种家族中选择表现最好的语言作为比较基线;本表提供了完整的图片.

blocks.en: Two findings stand out. First, performance varies substantially across languages. For Llama3-8B on MMLU-Redux SLVP, English reaches 0.523 while Khmer falls to 0.309, a gap of over 20 points. Even high-resource languages such as English and Chinese do not consistently yield the best results. Second, SLCP generally outperforms SLVP, confirming that prompt concatenation itself contributes gains, but SLCP still lags behind MLCP and fluctuates across languages. The optimal language also shifts depending on model, benchmark, and variant, making it difficult for users to pre-select a single best language. This variability motivates MLCP: by composing semantically equivalent role prompts across multiple languages in one context, the model can exploit complementary representational cues and reduce reliance on any single language choice.
blocks.zh: 有两个发现是突出的。 第一,各语文的表现差别很大。 对于MMLU-Redux SLVP上的Llama3-8B,英语达到0.523,而高棉语下降到0.309,差距超过20分. 甚至英语和汉语等高资源语言也未能取得一致的最佳效果. 第二,SLCP一般表现优于SLVP,证实即时协和本身有助于增益,但SLCP仍然落后于MLCP,并且跨语言波动. 最佳语言也依模型,基准和变体而变化,使得用户难以预先选择单一的最佳语言. 这种可变性激发了MLCP:通过在一种语境下编集多种语言的等效角色提示,该模型可以利用互补的代表提示,减少对任何单一语言选择的依赖.
